root_idea.summary: The root centers on bringing dispersed things together and carrying or holding them as a collected load.
root_idea.development: The basic orientation of gathering and carrying yields concrete terms for a measured load and a gathered herd, as well as Quranic uses for what night gathers and for the moon's attaining coherent fullness.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Distinct Quran-attested Form I verb meaning to gather or contain what is dispersed.
Distinct Quran-attested Form VIII construction describing coming together into fullness and regularity.

senses.definition: To gather and contain what is dispersed.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression وَاللَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ, the object is understood as what night gathers, including the darkness or nocturnal things and visitors.

senses.definition: To come together into a coherent, complete, and orderly state.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic description of the moon, it denotes attaining fullness or becoming fully coherent and regular.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel's load; by extension, a conventional measure of sixty ṣāʿs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun for a defined load or measure.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To load a camel with its burden.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form IV use applied to loading a camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make grain into a wasq, assigning it to the standard load measure.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative Form II use applied specifically to grain being made into a wasq.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To hold or carry water, said of the eye.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the eye retaining water; also found in the idiomatic expression “as long as my eye holds water.”

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel, or camels, bearing a load.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival or substantivized description of female camel(s) carrying their loads.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A gathered or driven herd or mob of camels or cattle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A collective noun for animals assembled and moved together.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bird that flaps its wings while flying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare lexical item; the form may also be pronounced with hamza.

lane_unit_coverage.note: The unit directly defines وَسْقٌ as a camel's load.
The unit directly defines وَسِيقَةٌ as a mob of driven cattle.

cautions: The Quranic interpretation of what night gathers in 84:17 is reported in more than one way: as darkness or as nocturnal things and visitors.
مِيسَاقٌ is reported as a rare, anomalous lexical branch rather than a central application of the root.
